title: He / She + s
hook_voice: Lesson twenty-two. He works. She lives in Samarkand.
hook_say: U haqida gapirsangiz, fe'lga bitta harf qo'shiladi!

example.en: She lives in Samarkand. She works every day.
example.uz: U Samarqandda yashaydi. U har kuni ishlaydi.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga yigirma uchinchi darsda ko'rishamiz.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 22-dars: inglizcha «He / She + s».

He works every day — U har kuni ishlaydi
She lives in Samarkand — U Samarqandda yashaydi
He drinks tea — U choy ichadi

He yoki she bilan fe'l oxiriga -s qo'shiladi: I work — he works, I live — she lives. I va you bilan qo'shilmaydi.
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 23-dars: Inkor: qilmayman.
